# Silver Rail Children's Fund

> Silver Rail Children's Fund is a parent-run Oregon public benefit nonprofit corporation (Oregon Registry No. 264524597, Tax ID 43-2607169) in Bend, Oregon. It is a survivor fund for every child who was enrolled at or present at Silver Rail Elementary School on October 15, 2026, the day of the shooting there, plus their siblings at home and the children of adults who were in the building. A 501(c)(3) application is in progress. Tax-deductible donations can be made now through VictimsFirst (a national 501(c)(3), EIN 32-0656956) at https://victimsfirst.org/donate, designated "Silver Rail Children's Fund"; 100% is passed through with no administrative fee.

## How it works
- A parent registers a child once and shows one ordinary piece of school paperwork to confirm enrollment; the fund looks and does not keep it.
- From then on, the parent tells the fund what would help the child (a class, a sport, a camp, counseling, a day out) and the fund pays the business or provider directly.
- Support follows the child to any school or town until the child's 25th birthday, as funds allow.
- Businesses are paid by default; donating or discounting is welcome but never expected.
- The fund keeps five fields per family and shares nothing with anyone. A monthly public ledger shows every dollar in and out by category, never by child.
- No board member is paid, and no board member can approve a request for their own child.
